title: Vector Quantizer Encoder
text: Index of nearest codeword based on Euclidean or weighted Euclidean distance measure, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Source of codebook}, {Codebook}, {Distortion measure} sets the measure of distortion, {Source of weighting factor}, {Weighting factor}, {Tie-breaking rule}, {Output codeword}, {Output quantization error}, {Index output data type}, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Product output}, {Word length} sets the product output word length, {Fraction length} sets the product output fraction length and {Accumulator}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Source of codebook
params.values: Source of codebook Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Distortion measure
params.values: Measure of distortion Squared error (default) | Weighted squared error

params.name: Source of weighting factor
params.values: Source of weighting factor Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Tie-breaking rule
params.values: Tie-breaking rule Choose the lower index (default) | Choose the higher index

params.name: Index output data type
params.values: Index output data type int32 (default) | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | uint32 | Inherit via back propagation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Word length
params.values: Product output word length 16 (default) | positive integer in range [2,128]

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Same as product output (default) | Same as input | Binary point scaling
